title: Trump Wants to Rename AI and Launch an AI Force

claims.text: On Saturday, Trump posted a poll on Truth Social asking followers to pick a new name for AI: Superior Intelligence, Extreme Intelligence, or Supreme Intelligence.
Trump called the AI backlash a Democratic hoax and offered no evidence for that claim.
Trump says he is forming an AI Force, modeled on the Space Force, and will announce an AI czar in the near future.
Trump did not say what the AI Force will do.
evidence_terms: did not say what the AI Force

scenes: Medium shot of the presenter addressing the camera. A lower-third graphic reads: Trump: Time to Rename AI. The TechCrunch headline appears on a side panel.

Slow push-in to a close-up as the presenter speaks. An on-screen graphic displays the three poll options stacked vertically: Superior Intelligence, Extreme Intelligence, Supreme Intelligence, with a Truth Social poll icon.

Side-angle shot of the presenter turning toward a floating graphic that reads: AI Force, with a smaller tag underneath: Modeled on Space Force. AI Czar: Coming Soon. The presenter gestures toward it, then the graphic fades and the camera returns to a medium shot.
script: You may know it as artificial intelligence, but President Trump thinks that name needs work. On Saturday, he posted a poll on Truth Social asking followers to pick a new one: Superior Intelligence, Extreme Intelligence, or Supreme Intelligence. He also called the AI backlash a Democratic hoax, though he offered no evidence for that. And he says he is forming an AI Force, modeled on the Space Force, with an AI czar to be announced soon. What that force will actually do, nobody has said yet.

news.title: Trump says it’s time to rebrand AI with a new name — and he’s also creating an AI Force
news.summary: Trump claimed, without evidence, that the AI backlash is a Democratic hoax.
